Notes.Arabic: ملاحظة: لا يتم تخزين مفتاح JWT داخل هذا الملف لأسباب أمنية. يتم قراءته من Windows Environment Variables. يجب إنشاء المتغيرات التالية قبل تشغيل المشروع: Jwt__Key و Jwt__Issuer و Jwt__Audience و Jwt__ExpireMinutes.
Notes.English: Note: The JWT secret key is not stored in this file for security reasons. It is loaded from Windows Environment Variables. Before running the project, create the following variables: Jwt__Key, Jwt__Issuer, Jwt__Audience, and Jwt__ExpireMinutes.
Notes.Turkish: Not: Güvenlik nedeniyle JWT anahtarı bu dosyada saklanmaz. Anahtar Windows Environment Variables üzerinden okunur. Projeyi çalıştırmadan önce şu değişkenleri oluşturun: Jwt__Key, Jwt__Issuer, Jwt__Audience ve Jwt__ExpireMinutes.
